mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact invertible canonical-charge coordinates, original and same-field Lorentz-well modifications, reconstructed Bardeen potentials and finite-interval transfer witnesses.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact rational functions using SymPy; double precision adaptive integration; independent 50-digit fixed-step RK4.
mathematics.conventions: As pinned reduced ADM action; state z=(Phi,dPhi/dlog(a),H P/Q,canonical charge contrast). Q>0, timelike homogeneous scalar. Both scalar modes retained.

bounds.background: Exact exponential well plus Lambda only, eps=1e-9, Q0=1, F10=-1.86/(1-eps), H0=1, healing length 4 pc. Scalar and Lambda background; no baryonic/radiation dynamics.
bounds.response: alpha=.5 v/(.5+v), v=1e-7 a^-4,c2=.03, exact alphadot
bounds.fundamental_matrix: DOP853 rtol 1e-9 and 1e-11, maximum step Delta log a/100, discrepancy <1e-5.
bounds.precision: Initial z=(1,0,0,0). Original response (.1,.001,.5); Lorentz constant (.1,.1,.1). 50-digit RK4 2000/4000 steps, plus independently stepped DOP853 with high-precision coefficient evaluation; relative differences <2e-6.
bounds.development_failure: For the response witness, 1000/2000 step comparison missed the 2e-6 threshold (2.177921e-6); the final check uses doubled resolutions. The tolerance was not relaxed.
